Body.Content:
Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub. Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge. Preview and playback video directly in chat, then continue iterating towards a finished video.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: December CY2026
